story.title: From Vietnamese Highlands to the World: Sustainable Multi-Origin Coffee Excellence.
story.body: Established in 2012 as Sapa Blue Mountain, SAPA LEGEND was built on deep highland heritage and specialty coffee expertise. As a premier Global Coffee Brand Partner, Sapa Legend bridges over 3,500 farming households across Vietnam's iconic origins—Son La, Lam Dong, Quang Tri, and Laos—with international markets. Supplying over 5,000 MT of green coffee beans annually and operating a modern 5,000 m² manufacturing facility in Phu Tho (expanding to 20,000 m² by 2028), Sapa Legend delivers end-to-end multi-origin green beans, custom OEM/private-label roasting, instant freeze-dried solutions, and ESG-aligned transparent supply chain management across 15+ export destinations worldwide.

highlights.title: Multi-Origin Green Coffee Sourcing
highlights.body: Direct origin sourcing across Arabica (Son La, Lam Dong, Laos), Robusta (Lam Dong, Central Highlands), and rare Liberica (Quang Tri). Available in commercial and specialty grades with S13–S18 screen sorting.

highlights.title: OEM & Private Label Roasting
highlights.body: Modern manufacturing producing roasted whole bean, precision ground coffee, and drip bag filter packs tailored to buyer formulations and export quality specifications.

highlights.title: ODM Product Innovation & Formulation
highlights.body: Translating target-market insights into commercial coffee products—from blend formulation and sensory validation to roast profiling, packaging design, and regulatory export compliance.

highlights.title: Freeze-Dried & Spray-Dried Instant Coffee
highlights.body: Advanced soluble instant coffee production with moisture <5% and caffeine >1.5%, retaining rich roast aromatics and smooth crema for retail packaging and industrial bulk supply.

commercialBlocks.title: Commercial Portfolio & Export Supply Capabilities
commercialBlocks.note: Supplied in 60 kg export jute/PP woven bags or 1,000 kg bulk jumbo bags. Full traceability, sample development, and custom OEM packaging available upon RFQ.
